title: Dense Feature Representation over Sequence Modeling: A Solution to the KDD Cup 2026 UniRec Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2609.19787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We describe our 10th-place solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, industrial click-to-conversion (CVR) prediction over 34.82M records, and we ask which mechanisms actually move held-out AUC. Starting from the official PCVRHyFormer baseline, a 15-step single-variable chain raises test AUC from 0.813237 to 0.827816, and our final submission reaches 0.828535. A leave-one-out ablation from the full model attributes the gain: removing the dense-feature representation stack costs 0.0095 AUC and removing the orthogonalized optimizer costs 0.0028, while no sequence-modeling component (merged single-stream backbone, polarity channel, auxiliary head, per-token FFN) costs more than 0.0005, within or adjacent to a $\pm$0.0004 seed band. We also report a generalization hazard: the row-group train/validation split shares one time window, so validation AUC overstates the leaderboard by about 0.014; anti-memorization and high-cardinality

translated_title: 稠密特征表征优于序列建模：KDD Cup 2026 UniRec挑战赛的一个解决方案
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.19787v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：我们描述了在KDD Cup 2026腾讯UniRec挑战赛中获得第十名的解决方案，该任务是基于3482万条记录的工业级点击转化率（CVR）预测，我们探究了哪些机制真正提升了留出集AUC。从官方PCVRHyFormer基线出发，通过15步单变量递进链条，将测试AUC从0.813237提升至0.827816，最终提交方案达到0.828535。从完整模型出发的留一法消融实验对增益进行了归因：移除稠密特征表征堆栈会损失0.0095的AUC，移除正交化优化器会损失0.0028，而任何序列建模组件（合并单流主干、极性通道、辅助头、逐token前馈网络）的移除损失均不超过0.0005，处于±0.0004种子波动带内或其附近。我们还报告了一个泛化风险：行组训练/验证划分共享同一时间窗口，因此验证AUC比排行榜分数高估了约0.014；反记忆化和高基数……
tldr: 该论文提出KDD Cup 2026腾讯UniRec挑战赛第十名方案，通过严格消融实验证明稠密特征表征（贡献0.0095 AUC）和正交化优化器（贡献0.0028 AUC）才是提升CVR预测性能的关键，而各类序列建模组件的贡献均可忽略不计。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a 10th-place solution to the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, demonstrating through leave-one-out ablations that dense feature representations (0.0095 AUC) and an orthogonalized optimizer (0.0028 AUC) drive the CVR prediction gains, while sequence-modeling components contribute negligibly.
